wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2020–21 |team=Colgate Raiders |image=Colgate Raiders (2020) logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Patriot League |division=North Division |short_conf=Patriot |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=14–2 |conf_record=11–1 |head_coach=[[Matt Langel]] |hc_year=10th |asst_coach1=[[Dave Klatsky]] |asst_coach2=Shawn Trice |asst_coach3=Pat Moore |stadium=[[Cotterell Court]] |champion=Patriot League North division champions and [[2021 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |tourney= [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = first round }} {{2020–21 Patriot League men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Colgate Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Colgate University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Raiders, were led by tenth-year head coach [[Matt Langel]], play their home games at [[Cotterell Court]] in [[Hamilton (village), New York|Hamilton, New York]] as members of the [[Patriot League]]. With the creation of mini-divisions to cut down on travel due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they played in the North Division.{{Cite news|url=https://patriotleague.org/news/2020/11/9/mens-basketball-patriot-league-plan-on-2021-basketball-season-starting-in-january.aspx|title=Patriot League Plan on 2021 Basketball Season Starting in January|work=Patriot League|date=November 9, 2020|accessdate=January 12, 2021|language=en}} They finished the season 14–2, 11–1 in Patriot League Play to finish as champions of the North Division. They defeated [[2020–21 Boston University Terriers men's basketball team|Boston University]], [[2020–21 Bucknell Bison men's basketball team|Bucknell]], and [[2020–21 Loyola Greyhounds men's basketball team|Loyola (MD)]] to be champions of the [[2021 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]]. They received the conference’s automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2020–21 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Colgate Raiders men's basketball team|Raiders]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 25–9, 14–4 in Patriot League play to win the Patriot League regular season championship. They defeated [[2019–20 Lehigh Mountain Hawks men's basketball team|Lehigh]]{{Cite news|url=https://gocolgateraiders.com/news/2020/3/5/mens-basketball-colgate-closes-out-lehigh-83-70.aspx|title=Colgate Closes out Lehigh, 83-70|work=Colgate University Athletics|date=March 5, 2020|accessdate=January 12, 2021|language=en}} and [[2019–20 Lafayette Leopards men's basketball team|Lafayette]]{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game?gameId=401211658|title=Lafayette vs. Colgate - Game Summary|work=ESPN|date=March 8, 2020|accessdate=January 12, 2021|language=en}} to reach the championship game of the [[2020 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]], where they lost to [[2019–20 Boston University Terriers men's basketball team|Boston University]].{{Cite news|url=https://patriotleague.org/news/2020/3/11/no-3-boston-university-claims-first-patriot-league-mens-basketball-championship-3-11-20.aspx|title=No. 3 Boston University Claims First Patriot League Men's Basketball Championship|work=Patriot League|date=March 11, 2020|accessdate=January 12, 2021|language=en}} As a regular season league champion who failed to win their league tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2020 National Invitation Tournament]]. However, the NIT and all other postseason tournaments were cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite
